reports.title: Emotion coverage (books per emotion tag)
reports.query: MATCH (b:Book) UNWIND b.emotion_tags AS emotion RETURN emotion, count(*) AS books ORDER BY books DESC

reports.title: Top themes
reports.query: MATCH (t:Theme)<-[:HAS_THEME]-(b:Book) RETURN t.name AS theme, count(b) AS books ORDER BY books DESC LIMIT 12

reports.title: Books per era
reports.query: MATCH (e:Era)<-[:SET_IN]-(b:Book) RETURN e.name AS era, count(b) AS books

reports.title: Books per region
reports.query: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:FROM_REGION]-(b:Book) RETURN r.name AS region, count(b) AS books

reports.title: Most prolific authors
reports.query: MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(b:Book) RETURN a.name AS author, count(b) AS books ORDER BY books DESC LIMIT 10

reports.title: Live graph sample — books and their connections
reports.query: MATCH (b:Book)-[r]->(n) WITH b, r, n LIMIT 120 RETURN b, r, n
